title: uriahtalks
text: current smoking object reconstructs published conditional-exchangeability example: 16 people. 6 x = 0, 10 x = 1. E[Y0] = 7/16, E[Y1] = 11/16, true ATE = 4/16 = 0.25. Four (Y0, Y1) = (0, 1) responders, PNS = 4/16 = 0.25 monotonicity. Observational treatment rates 2/6 8/10. observational assignment keeps treatment rates 2/6 8/10. naïve contrast 7/15; adjustment gives 21/64, moving toward landing exactly true ATE. balanced experimental assignment frozen experimental deck’s set.seed(42) construction.
